strengths.definition: Syntax, schema, closed-world shape, type, and governed vocabulary checks.
Structural validation plus RAES domain invariants, reference resolution, lifecycle separation, and cross-artifact consistency.
Semantic validation plus a concrete processor, backend, conformance, runtime, or admission path that exercised the relevant behavior.
Semantic or behavioral validation backed by preserved evidence, provenance, diagnostics, and limitations sufficient for review.
Evidence-backed validation with an explicit falsification protocol and governed evidence status.

subject_kinds.definition: An experiment task protocol and its declared support.
An archival experiment run and its provenance.
An experiment study, allocation, and analysis plan.
A governed claim about backend conformance.
A governed claim about participant conformance.
A published claim or report artifact.

gate_kinds.definition: The subject parses under its declared syntax.
The subject conforms to its published closed schema.
Portable terms resolve against their governed vocabularies.
RAES domain invariants have been evaluated.
Required references resolve within their governed authority.
Authored, planned, realized, observed, and derived facts remain separated.
Related artifacts satisfy their declared join and consistency rules.
A concrete processor, backend, runtime, conformance, or admission path exercised the relevant behavior.
The exercised path returned bounded governed diagnostics.
Reviewable evidence or artifact references are preserved.
Evidence and results retain their governed provenance chain.
Coverage limits, redactions, omissions, and unsupported behavior are explicit.
An explicit falsification protocol is bound to the claim.
The falsification evidence carries a governed ADR-021 evidence status.

limitation_categories.definition: No semantic or behavioral claim follows from this basis.
No concrete behavioral path was exercised.
The basis covers only a declared subset of the subject or behavior.
The result depends on a declared implementation or environment.
Expected evidence is unavailable to the audience.
Evidence exists but is intentionally withheld.
Evidence has been redacted for the receiving audience.
Only part of the expected evidence chain is available.
A relevant capability is unsupported by the exercised path.
The exposed basis is weaker than an internal view because of audience restrictions.

profiles.title: RAES structural validation
evidence_expectations: Identify the published schema or parser version used.
diagnostic_expectations: Report bounded contract paths and governed diagnostic codes.

profiles.title: RAES semantic validation
evidence_expectations: Identify the semantic validator and the governed authority revisions used.
diagnostic_expectations: Report failed invariant and reference identifiers without rejected payload bodies.

profiles.title: RAES behavioral validation
evidence_expectations: Identify the concrete processor, backend, runtime, conformance, or admission path exercised.
diagnostic_expectations: Preserve the governed diagnostics returned by the exercised path.

profiles.title: RAES evidence-backed validation
evidence_expectations: Preserve reviewable evidence, provenance, diagnostics, and limitations for the declared basis.
diagnostic_expectations: Expose governed diagnostic or artifact references appropriate to the audience.

profiles.title: RAES falsification-backed validation
evidence_expectations: Bind the claim to an explicit falsification protocol, reviewable evidence, provenance, and ADR-021 evidence status.
diagnostic_expectations: Expose governed falsification outcomes and bounded evidence references.
